title: Probing Visual Idiosyncrasies in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models turn short text descriptions into images, and the leading models now produce images of comparable visual quality. Whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics matters for attribution, for model comparison beyond aggregate quality, and for evaluations that assume anonymity. We ask whether images from frontier T2I models can still be classified by source, and which visual properties make this possible. Here we show that a standard ResNet-50 identifies the source of an image among HiDream-O1-Dev, FLUX.2-dev, HunyuanImage-3.0, and Qwen-Image-2512, the four highest-ranked open-source models on the Text-to-Image Arena, with 100.00% accuracy on held-out prompts. Human participants reach only 62.61% on the pairwise version of this task, so the distinguishing cues are not visually obvious. They are also not tied to a particular classifier and survive severe image corruptions and out-of-distribution

translated_title: 探究文本到图像模型中的视觉特异性
translated_abstract: 文本到图像（T2I）模型能够将简短的文本描述转化为图像，目前领先的模型已能生成视觉质量相当的图像。它们的输出是否仍带有模型特有的特征，对于图像来源归因、超越整体质量的模型比较，以及那些假设匿名性的评估而言都十分重要。我们探究了来自前沿T2I模型的图像是否仍可按来源进行分类，以及是哪些视觉特性使这成为可能。我们的研究表明，一个标准的ResNet-50能够在HiDream-O1-Dev、FLUX.2-dev、HunyuanImage-3.0和Qwen-Image-2512这四个在Text-to-Image Arena排行榜上排名最高的开源模型中识别图像的来源，在留出的提示词上达到100.00%的准确率。而人类参与者在此任务的成对比较版本中仅达到62.61%的准确率，说明这些区分性线索在视觉上并不明显。这些线索也不依赖于特定分类器，并且能够在严重的图像损坏和分布外（数据）条件下保持有效（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究发现，一个普通的ResNet-50能以100%的准确率识别前沿文本到图像模型生成图像的来源，而人类仅有62.61%的准确率，表明各模型输出中仍隐藏着人类难以察觉且非常稳健的模型特有视觉特征。
en_tdlr: A standard ResNet-50 can identify the source of images generated by frontier text-to-image models with 100.00% accuracy—far surpassing humans at 62.61%—revealing hidden, robust model-specific visual signatures in their outputs.
